title: Charles Dickens' Early Life
prompt: Describe Charles Dickens' childhood and family background.
hint: Include details about his birth date, parents, siblings, and early hardships.
sample: Charles Dickens was born on February 7, 1812, to John and Elizabeth Dickens. He was the second of eight children, and his family faced financial difficulties during his childhood.

title: Charles Dickens' Work and Ambitions
prompt: Explain how Charles Dickens started working and his ambitions during his youth.
hint: Mention his early jobs, family financial situation, and his drive to succeed.
sample: At age 12, Charles worked in a blacking factory labeling bottles for eleven hours a day. Despite hardships, he was ambitious and later began working as a clerk and started a writing career.

title: Charles Dickens' Writing Career and Personal Life
prompt: Summarize Charles Dickens' writing career and key events in his personal life.
hint: Include his first publication, marriage, travels, and rumors about his life.
sample: Charles began his writing career in 1831, published his first fiction in 1835, married Catherine Hogarth the same year, traveled to America and Italy, and faced rumors about his personal life.

ja.sample: チャールズは1831年に作家活動を始め、1835年に最初の小説を出版し、同年キャサリン・ホガースと結婚しました。アメリカやイタリアを旅行し、私生活に関する噂にも直面しました。

title: Charles Dickens' Later Life and Death
prompt: Describe the major events in Charles Dickens' later life and his death.
hint: Mention his purchase of Gads Hill, relationship with Ellen Ternan, the train accident, and his death.
sample: In his later years, Dickens bought Gads Hill, met Ellen Ternan, survived a train accident where he helped the injured, but his health declined and he died of a stroke in 1870.
